baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction ينقلب إلى أهله makes turning a directed arrival, while مسرورا predicates the state carried into that arrival.
baseline_models.mechanism: Return/destination, social belonging, and joy/ease form a compact movement: a person turns toward a group defined by nearness and reaches it in delight rather than merely changing location.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies return and destination; it makes ينقلب the directed homeward movement of the model.
The branch supplies people bound by closeness and belonging; it gives the destination its relational rather than merely spatial character.
The branch supplies joy and ease opposed to hardship; it names the affective condition in which the return is completed.

changed_reading.before: He simply goes back to his family while happy.
changed_reading.after: He makes a directed homecoming into a bond of belonging, with joy and ease constituting the manner and result of arrival.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ينقلب carries a turning root that also names the inward faculty, and مسرورا can hold something concealed within.
baseline_models.mechanism: The visible turn toward أهل can co-activate an inward turn: the traveler changes direction while the inner faculty changes state, and the resulting joy is carried inside rather than exhausted by outward motion.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies reversal from one face or state to another; it anchors the visible and dispositional turn.
The branch supplies the heart and inward faculty; it opens an interior register within the same turning root.
The branch supplies fitness and worthiness for a place; it lets belonging register as an achieved alignment as well as kinship.
The branch supplies something kept hidden inwardly; it makes joy an interior content accompanying the turn.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports only an external return and an obvious emotion.
changed_reading.after: The external return doubles as an inward reversal into fitness with one's destination, carrying a joy held in the interior.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The endpoint أهله and the state مسرورا can both be read spatially through familiar habitation and settled support.
baseline_models.mechanism: The destination is a familiar inhabited sphere, while joy thickens into repose on something that supports and settles. Homecoming therefore ends displacement, not only sadness.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies return and final destination; it carries the movement into an endpoint.
The branch supplies familiar habitation and the removal of wild estrangement; it renders أهل as an inhabited place of recognition.
The branch supplies a place of settled support or reclining; it turns joy into durable repose at the endpoint.

changed_reading.before: Joy is a passing mood displayed upon reaching home.
changed_reading.after: The return ends in familiar habitation and supported repose, so joy has the spatial weight of being settled again.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Both قلب and سرر inventories contain images of a pure or choicest core, with أهل between them as belonging.
baseline_models.mechanism: The line can resonate as movement from turning at the core toward the social core: the person reaches the innermost, choicest site of belonging, and مسرورا marks that core-state rather than generic cheerfulness.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies the pure essence or central core; it gives the turning verb a latent center-seeking geometry.
The branch supplies a collective formed by nearness and belonging; it makes the sought center social.
The branch supplies the purest or choicest inward place; it makes the joyful state coincide with arrival at a core.

changed_reading.before: The line links travel, family, and happiness in sequence.
changed_reading.after: The sequence also sketches a center-seeking return into the choicest core of relational belonging.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence makes the world split, extend, cast out its contents, and become empty. Against that outwarding, the focus ayah reverses vector: the person turns into familiar habitation and settled support. The homecoming becomes a human reentry after cosmic containers have discharged what was inside them.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies splitting and opening; it begins the context's outward release of enclosed contents.
The branch supplies drawing something lengthwise until it extends; it removes the earth's compact boundary.
The branch supplies casting a thing out until it lies outside; it gives the emptied interior an outward vector.
The branch supplies bareness and vacancy; it marks the completed emptying of the prior container.
The branch supplies reversal of face or state; it reverses the opening sequence's outward vector into a return.
The branch supplies familiar habitation; it functions as the new interior into which the person reenters.
The branch supplies settled support; it closes the release-and-reentry mechanism in repose.

structural_cues: 84:1-4 repeatedly moves from enclosure toward opening, extension, expulsion, and vacancy.
84:9 changes the dominant vector with ينقلب إلى, a turn toward an inhabited endpoint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sequence of opening and emptying followed by directed return; I infer a container-level reversal in which the person is gathered into a social interior. The live alternative is that the cosmic sequence is only a setting and supplies no material analogy for the return.

changed_reading.before: The person returns home after an event.
changed_reading.after: After the world's enclosures open and discharge their contents, the person undergoes the counter-movement of reentry into familiar, supportive belonging.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated cosmic clauses join receptive hearing, a Lord who repairs and completes, and a due state that must be fulfilled. Those cues activate the focus branch of أهل as fitness: the endpoint can be not only one's prior household but a belonging for which one has become apt after a demanded completion.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies attentive acceptance of what is heard; it begins a pattern of responsive alignment.
The branch supplies repair, nurture, and completion; it provides the process by which fitness may be achieved.
The branch supplies a fixed due and necessary entitlement; it frames completion as something properly fulfilled.
The branch supplies return to a destination; it carries the completed subject toward the resulting endpoint.
The branch supplies fitness or worthiness for a place; it recasts أهل as an apt destination rather than ancestry alone.

structural_cues: The sequence وأذنت لربها وحقت occurs twice, at 84:2 and 84:5.
The focus destination follows those two fulfilled-response clauses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies receptivity, completion, due fulfillment, and a focus branch of fitness; I infer that fulfilled alignment can qualify the subject for the destination. The alternative is that the repeated clauses characterize only sky and earth and do not revise أهل.

changed_reading.before: أهله denotes a household already possessed by kinship.
changed_reading.after: أهله can also denote the belonging for which the returning person has become fit through completed response and fulfilled due.

context_deltas.mechanism: 84:6 gives strenuous movement إلى ربك and an encounter; 84:9 gives movement إلى أهله. The repeated directional construction makes the second endpoint legible as downstream of the first: return to belonging does not evade encounter but follows it, with completion turning strain into joy.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies laborious striving; it loads the first directed movement with effort that needs resolution.
The branch supplies nurturing repair and completion; it makes the first endpoint potentially transformative rather than merely terminal.
The branch supplies the coming together of two facing terms; it marks an encounter between striving and homecoming.
The branch supplies return and destination; it begins the second directed leg after encounter.
The branch supplies a near collective of belonging; it defines the relational endpoint of the second leg.
The branch supplies joy and ease after hardship; it converts the prior striving into a resolved affective state.

structural_cues: 84:6 and 84:9 both organize motion with إلى followed by a personal or relational endpoint.
The encounter at the end of 84:6 precedes the account and the return of 84:9.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two directional endpoints, intervening encounter, and sequence; I infer a continuous itinerary from strenuous approach through encounter to joyful return. The alternative is that the two إلى constructions are parallel descriptions without a causal or temporal bridge.

changed_reading.before: The return to family is relief separate from the prior striving toward the Lord.
changed_reading.after: The return to belonging is the second leg of the same itinerary and its joy is post-encounter resolution of the earlier strain.

context_deltas.mechanism: A record that fixes judgment is given on the side of blessing, the count is performed, and constriction opens into ease. This sequence supplies a causal hinge for the focus return: the account no longer blocks movement, so joy is the felt release of a settled reckoning.

The branch supplies blessing and good fortune; it colors the side on which the record is received.
The branch supplies counting and account; it performs the settlement that precedes release.

The branch supplies ease and delight opposed to hardship; it makes joy the experiential form of the account's release.

structural_cues: The focus ayah is linked by ف to the easy account immediately before it.
Record reception, accounting, ease, and return occur without an intervening scene change.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a fixed record, favorable side, completed count, ease, and immediate ف-sequence; I infer that settled accounting enables the return and produces its joy. The alternative is a looser list of favorable outcomes with no enabling arrow.

changed_reading.before: Joy merely accompanies arrival at the household.
changed_reading.after: Joy is the release generated when a fixed account has been settled with ease and no longer obstructs return.

context_deltas.mechanism: 84:13 repeats أهل and مسرورا but places joy داخل the household in a prior state; 84:14 then names the mistaken denial of return, while 84:15 supplies penetrating sight. The echo prevents household joy from being self-validating. What distinguishes 84:9 is directional return after account, whereas the mirrored joy is an enclosure sustained by believing that no return will occur.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies return and destination; it is the decisive movement present in the focus scene.
The branch supplies near belonging; it is the shared social setting whose value changes with temporal direction.
The branch supplies joy and ease; it is the shared affect that the mirrored scenes force the reader to differentiate.
The branch again supplies relational closeness; here it forms the enclosure within which prior joy was enjoyed.
The branch again supplies joy and ease; its recurrence proves that affect alone cannot distinguish the two readings.
The branch supplies return and diminution; its explicit negation exposes the premise underlying the earlier household joy.
The branch supplies inward insight; it opposes the subject's assumption with a seeing that reaches beneath visible happiness.

structural_cues: 84:9 has إلى أهله مسرورا, while 84:13 has في أهله مسرورا.
The first scene is future return after account; the second is a past state followed by the belief that return would never happen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact lexical echo, opposed prepositions and tenses, denied return, and inward sight; I infer that the echo is contrastive and makes direction through accountability the diagnostic difference. The alternative is that the repetition only marks two unrelated instances of family happiness.

changed_reading.before: Being joyful with one's people is itself the favorable content of 84:9.
changed_reading.after: Household joy is morally and temporally ambiguous; 84:9 becomes favorable because it is joy reached through return and account, not joy enclosed within denial of return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Twilight yields to night, night gathers, the moon comes into full coherence, and the addressee rides state after state. This phase grammar activates ينقلب as a transition within a layered passage rather than one backward step. أهل and مسرورا become the phase in which gathering finally settles into supported repose.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies the red twilight at sunset; it opens the explicit sequence of changing phases.

The branch supplies gathering dispersed things together; it gives night a collecting function in the phase sequence.
The branch supplies completion, regularity, and coherence; it turns gathering into a fulfilled phase.
The branch supplies the moon and its light; it gives the completed phase a visible celestial body.
The branch supplies one thing riding or stacking upon another; it makes passage cumulative rather than a simple reset.
The branch supplies state after state; it explicitly generalizes the phase-by-phase mechanism.
The branch supplies change from one face or state to another; it places the return within the larger sequence of transitions.
The branch supplies settled support; it gives the layered passage a phase of repose without claiming it is the only final phase.

structural_cues: 84:16-19 advances through twilight, night, gathered contents, completed moon, and layer upon layer.
The focus verb already encodes change of direction or state and therefore can participate in this phase grammar.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered cosmic phase sequence and an explicit state-after-state construction; I infer that the earlier personal turn is one coherent passage within that pattern. The alternative is that the oath sequence describes universal change without retroactively structuring 84:9.

changed_reading.before: ينقلب is a single backward movement ending at home.
changed_reading.after: The homecoming is one gathered phase in a cumulative passage through state after state, with joy registering temporary or durable repose within transition.

context_deltas.mechanism: Late cues move from covering, through knowledge of what is held in the heart, to news that opens the skin with visible affect. These activate the focus's سرر branches of inward concealment and facial lines. مسرورا can therefore be read as an inner content that arrives with the person and becomes legible on the surface, while the ironic use of بشّر warns that surface affect and favorable outcome are not identical.

The branch supplies the inward faculty; it gives the returning subject an interior site that can carry joy.
The branch supplies something hidden inwardly; it makes مسرورا first an interior condition.
The branch supplies lines of palm and forehead; it gives inward joy a possible bodily inscription without reducing it to appearance.
The branch supplies joy and ease; it identifies the actual affect whose concealment and display are being related.

structural_cues: 84:22-24 moves from covering, to knowledge of contained material, to a speech act conventionally associated with visible joy.
The focus places an affective participle after arrival, allowing state to be carried across the motion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covering, inward containment, disclosure to knowledge, and skin-opening news; I infer an inward-to-outward affective path for مسرورا. The alternative is that these late roots concern belief and punishment only and do not specify how the focus joy is embodied.

changed_reading.before: مسرورا is an uncomplicated visible smile or generic happiness.
changed_reading.after: مسرورا is joy carried as inward content and potentially written onto the face, while the later ironic glad-tidings image keeps visible affect from becoming a sufficient verdict.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence joins intended action, fitness, recompense, and explicit non-cutting. It retroactively lengthens the focus joy: return into a fit belonging is not merely an instant of relief but can open into recompensed repose whose extension is not severed.

structural_cues: 84:25 closes the surah with a reward modified by غير ممنون.
The focus's joy and settled-support branches leave duration unspecified until this ending activates continuity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies suitable action, recompense, and negated cutting; I infer that the closing duration can color the earlier joy as sustained repose. The alternative is that 84:25 concerns a separately named group and should not determine the temporal quality of 84:9.

changed_reading.before: The joy of return is a momentary reaction at arrival.
changed_reading.after: The joy can be read as entry into fitting, recompensed repose whose extension is not cut off.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins the noun-distant mold branch of قلب to cross-domain images of splitting, bone union, fracture-setting, and suitability. It remains anchored in ينقلب, the focus branch of أهل as fitness, and the repeated packet mechanism of break followed by fit. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for re-formation, never as the lexical meaning of ينقلب or a claim about bodily reconstruction.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines a قلب form with أهل as fitness and مسرورا as settled support, allowing a tightly contained image of being recast into a fitting relation.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the return can image a fractured subject recast and set into a fitting belonging, where settled joy signals successful re-formation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the rare سرر image of the moon hidden at month-end through the later full moon, reading an affective participle through lunar phase. It remains anchored in مسرورا and ينقلب, and the packet directly supplies concealment, moon, completion, and state-change branches. Downstream prose should qualify it as a phase analogy for latent joy and return, not as an alternative dictionary gloss for مسرورا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مسرورا shares its root inventory with lunar concealment, while ينقلب supplies reversal from one state to another.

The branch supplies reversal from one state to another; it gives the hidden phase a return movement.
The branch supplies familiar habitation; it functions as the recognizable sphere to which the latent phase returns.
The branch supplies the moon and its light; it visibly activates the focus root's hidden-moon image.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, joy is a latent phase that has passed through concealment and returns into recognizable fullness, like the completed moon.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the noun-distant bracelet branch of قلب to give return a closed-loop geometry. It remains anchored in ينقلب, أهل as a bond of nearness, and the context's explicit gathering branch. Downstream prose should retain it only as a spatial image of completed relational circulation, not as a claim that the verse refers to jewelry or literal circular motion.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places a turning قلب form beside relational belonging and settled support, permitting a contained image of a loop closing around its members.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies a plain single bracelet or ring; it gives the return an exploratory closed-circuit shape.
The branch supplies people joined by closeness and belonging; it makes the proposed circuit relational rather than geometric alone.
The branch supplies settled support; it marks closure of the circuit as rest rather than confinement.
The branch supplies collecting dispersed things into a whole; it activates the ring as a gathering of separated members.

changed_reading.before: Return traverses a line from person to household.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, return closes a relational circuit, gathering a separated member back into the ring of belonging and rest.

strongest_changes: The repeated إلى turns 84:6 and 84:9 into a possible continuous itinerary: striving toward the Lord, encounter and account, then return toward belonging.
The exact أهل and مسرورا echo in 84:13 makes household joy ambiguous; the decisive contrast is return through accountability versus joy premised on no return.
The opening world's outward release makes the focus homecoming a counter-vector of reentry into familiar social support.
The easy account and the uncut ending let joy move from a passing mood to released, potentially durable repose.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah is unusually compact but its three roots each open both ordinary and latent registers: قلب joins destination, reversal, inward faculty, core, mold, and ring; أهل joins kinship, habitation, and fitness; سرر joins joy, concealment, bodily inscription, support, core, and lunar hiding. Context does not collapse these into one verdict. It sharpens several coexisting models and, through the mirrored wording of 84:13, shows that the same family-joy surface can carry opposed temporal and accountable structures.
remaining_uncertainties: أهله may remain a literal prior household, expand to an eligible collective, or sustain both readings; the packet does not force a single social referent.
The continuous itinerary inferred from the two إلى constructions is strongly sequential but still reader-supplied rather than grammatically explicit.
The inward-to-facial reading of مسرورا is branch-supported, but the degree of actual outward display remains unspecified.
The mold, lunar, and bracelet activations are coherent packet-triggered analogies but remain branch-distant and should never be rendered as direct lexical equivalences.
